title: Brazil INSS Contribution Calculator
description: Estimate the Brazilian employee INSS contribution with the 2026 progressive table, contribution ceiling, and band-by-band memory.
metaDescription: Estimate Brazilian employee INSS on salary with the 2026 progressive table, contribution ceiling, effective rate, and band-by-band memory.

helpers.base: Enter the monthly remuneration that composes the Brazilian salary-contribution base. The calculator does not classify payroll rubrics automatically.
helpers.otherPay: Use this to add taxable amounts or remuneration from other employment links in the same competence month.
helpers.category: This version uses the same table for employee, domestic employee, and avulso worker categories.
helpers.tableBadge: INSS 2026 table, effective from competence January 2026. Official sources accessed on 2026-06-24.
helpers.scope: Estimate of the insured person's contribution only; employer charges, IRRF, FGTS, payment forms, and official payroll are not included.

validation.salarioContribuicao: Enter a valid salary-contribution amount from R$0.00 to R$10,000,000.00.
validation.salarioContribuicaoObrigatorio: Enter a salary-contribution amount greater than zero.
validation.outrasRemuneracoes: Enter valid other remuneration from R$0.00 to R$10,000,000.00.
validation.tabelaAno: This version only uses the 2026 INSS table.

cards.effectiveRateHelper: INSS divided by the entered base

memo.title: Base and category
memo.helper: When there is more than one employment link, add the remunerations from the same competence month to estimate the monthly table and ceiling.

items.tabelaInss2026: Automatic calculation uses the 2026 INSS progressive table; future years require updated constants.
items.salarioAbaixoReferencia: The entered base is below the R$1,621.00 reference; proportional or special contracts may need separate review.
items.tetoAplicado: The entered base exceeds the R$8,475.55 ceiling; the contribution was capped at the social-security ceiling.
items.multiplosVinculos: Multiple employment links should consider remuneration from the same competence month together; employer-by-employer allocation is not calculated here.
items.decimoTerceiroSeparado: 13th salary is treated separately from monthly remuneration for this calculation.
items.estimativaEducativa: Educational estimate only; official payslip, eSocial, employer records, and professional review prevail.
items.fontesConsultadas: Official sources accessed on 2026-06-24: INSS, MPS/MF Ordinance No. 13/2026, and Receita incidence table.

method.title: Calculation memory.
method.text: The estimate adds salary and other entered remuneration, caps the base at the ceiling, and applies the 7.5%, 9%, 12%, and 14% progressive bands.
method.disclaimer: It does not generate GPS, DAE, DARF, eSocial, CNIS, payslips, or legal, tax, accounting, or social-security conclusions.

howToCalculate.title: How to calculate Brazilian INSS on salary in 2026
howToCalculate.p1: INSS for employee, domestic employee, and avulso worker categories uses a progressive table. Each slice of the contribution base falls into its own rate band.
howToCalculate.p2: The calculator adds entered salary and other remuneration from the same competence month, then calculates the contribution up to the 2026 ceiling.

table.title: 2026 progressive INSS table
table.p1: This version uses limits of R$1,621.00, R$2,902.84, R$4,354.27, and R$8,475.55, with rates of 7.5%, 9%, 12%, and 14%.
table.p2: The table was checked against official INSS sources on 2026-06-24 and is shown as effective from competence January 2026.

ceiling.title: INSS ceiling and effective rate
ceiling.text: When the base is above R$8,475.55, the contribution is capped. The effective rate shows how much INSS represents over the full entered base.

multipleJobs.title: INSS with more than one employment link
multipleJobs.text: Official guidance says remunerations from the same competence month should be considered together for the table and ceiling. This calculator estimates from the total typed value and does not split withholding across employers.

exclusions.title: What this calculator does not do
exclusions.p1: It does not calculate individual contributors, facultative contributors, MEI, autonomous workers, pro-labore, arrears, interest, payment forms, employer-side INSS, RAT, FAP, third-party charges, IRRF, FGTS, or benefits.
exclusions.p2: It also does not decide whether a bonus, allowance, reimbursement, legal settlement, or other payroll rubric integrates the salary-contribution base.

officialLinks.title: Official sources
officialLinks.intro: This version's constants were checked against official sources accessed on 2026-06-24.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This calculator is an educational estimate based on official 2026 sources accessed on 2026-06-24. Official payroll, eSocial, employer records, applicable agreements, and professional review prevail.

q1.question: Which INSS table is used?
q1.answer: The calculator uses the 2026 progressive table for employees, domestic employees, and avulso workers, effective from competence January 2026.

q2.question: Does it work for domestic employees?
q2.answer: Yes, for estimating the insured person's contribution with the same table. It does not calculate DAE, domestic eSocial, or employer charges.

q3.question: Does it work for MEI, autonomous workers, or individual contributors?
q3.answer: No. This version only covers employees, domestic employees, and avulso workers. MEI, autonomous, facultative, and pro-labore flows need separate calculators.

q4.question: How should I handle more than one job?
q4.answer: Add remuneration from the same competence month to estimate the table and ceiling. The calculator does not split the deduction across employers.

q5.question: Does 13th salary enter the monthly calculation?
q5.answer: No. Official guidance treats 13th salary separately from monthly remuneration for table framing.

q6.question: Why can my official payslip differ?
q6.answer: Official payroll may include rubrics, multiple links, rounding, eSocial setup, agreements, absences, and professional review that this estimate cannot access.
